dict.string: Remote for OpenCode uses the camera so you can send your agent a photo — a screenshot, a diagram, an error on another screen.
Remote for OpenCode confirms it's you before approving the agent's commands.
Remote for OpenCode connects to your Mac on your local network to run your coding agent. Your code never leaves your machines.
Remote for OpenCode uses the microphone so you can dictate prompts to your coding agent.
Remote for OpenCode transcribes your dictated prompts on this device. Nothing is sent to Apple or anyone else.
